Hermisan REST API · Odoo Integration

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST. Base URL: placeholder (real URLs are per-endpoint).

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "endpoints": {
    "endpoint_1": {
      "url": "https://xxxxx.hermisan.es",
      "username": "user",
      "password": "pass"
    },
    "endpoint_2": {
      "url": "https://yyyyy.hermisan.es",
      "username": "user",
      "password": "pass"
    }
  },
  "timezone": "Europe/Madrid"
}
  • endpoints: Required. Dictionary of endpoint keys to connection details. Each Hermisan physical server (PLC/SCADA) is one endpoint. A single installation may have multiple servers (e.g. one per pumping station group).
  • url: Base URL of the Hermisan server (e.g. https://crtorrecotillas.hermisan.es).
  • username / password: Basic Auth credentials.
  • timezone: Default IANA timezone for timestamp conversion (default: Europe/Madrid).

2) Authentication

Hermisan uses HTTP Basic Auth. Credentials are sent with every request. WARNING: Hermisan has strict fail2ban rules. Avoid sending wrong credentials repeatedly.

3) Rate Limiting

1 request per minute per endpoint. The system enforces this automatically.

4) API Endpoints

MethodEndpointParametersDescription
GET/API1/BOMBEOCHECK— Instantaneous data. Returns hierarchical JSON with current sensor values for all zones, pumping stations and pumps.
GET/API1/BOMBEOSTATS from, to (format: YYYY.MM.DD-HH:MM:SS) Historical pumping cycles. Returns rows with per-cycle statistics including water volume, power consumption, flow, pressure, and timestamps.

5) BOMBEOCHECK Response Structure

{
  "CAPTACIÓN RIO": {
    "BOMBEO RIO": {
      "Caudal impulsión": 0
    }
  },
  "EMBALSE A": {
    "Altura embalses": 1.8,
    "BOMBEO A": {
      "Presión impulsión": 0.1,
      "Caudal impulsión": 0,
      "BOMBA 1": {"Potencia Consumida": 0},
      "BOMBA 2": {"Potencia Consumida": 0}
    }
  }
}

Hierarchical: Zone → (zone-level sensors + Pumping Stations) → (station-level sensors + Pumps) → pump sensors.

6) BOMBEOSTATS Response Structure

{
  "ID": 0,
  "rows": [
    {
      "_balsa": 3,
      "Balsa": "EMBALSE B",
      "Fecha": "18/03/2026 11:34",
      "_pozo": 2,
      "Pozo": "BOMBEO A",
      "Marcha": "00:11:29",
      "_timeStart": "1773830060525",
      "_timeEnd": "1773830749525",
      "Agua": 67,
      "Altura embalses": 1.65,
      "Potencia Consumida": 31.92,
      "Caudal impulsión": 371.05,
      "Presión impulsión": 10.5,
      "_bombas": {
        "BOMBA 1": {"Potencia Consumida": 15.09},
        "BOMBA 2": {"Potencia Consumida": 8.30}
      },
      "Bombas": " / BOMBA 1 / BOMBA 2 / ..."
    }
  ]
}

Fields:

  • _timeStart / _timeEnd: Epoch milliseconds (pumping cycle boundaries).
  • Agua: Total water volume in m³ for the cycle.
  • Potencia Consumida: Total power in kW·h for the cycle.
  • Caudal impulsión: Average flow in m³/h.
  • Presión impulsión: Average pressure (bar or mca).
  • Altura embalses: Reservoir level in mca (meters of water column).
  • Marcha: Duration string HH:MM:SS.
  • _bombas: Per-pump power breakdown.

7) Odoo Configuration

Device (mdm.measurement.device) remotecontrol_params:

Each device represents a Hermisan pumping station (Pozo).

{
  "endpoint_key": "endpoint_1",
  "pozo_key": "BOMBEO A",
  "zone_key": "EMBALSE A",
  "pozo_id": 2,
  "balsa_id": 3,
  "start_date": "2026-01-01"
}
  • endpoint_key: Required. Key in the remotecontrol endpoints dict.
  • pozo_key: Required. Name of the pumping station as returned by the API.
  • zone_key: Zone/reservoir name this station belongs to.
  • pozo_id: Numeric _pozo id from BOMBEOSTATS.
  • balsa_id: Numeric _balsa id from BOMBEOSTATS.
  • start_date: Optional. Start date for first data retrieval (YYYY-MM-DD).

Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) remotecontrol_params:

Each sensor represents a measurable variable within a pumping station.

{
  "variable": "Caudal impulsión"
}

For per-pump sensors:

{
  "variable": "Potencia Consumida",
  "bomba": "BOMBA 1"
}
  • variable: Required. Name of the variable as returned by the API.
  • bomba: Optional. Pump name (for per-pump breakdown sensors).

8) Operational Flow

  1. Catalog Sync: Health check → Call BOMBEOCHECK on each endpoint → Auto-detect zones, pumping stations, pumps → Auto-create mdm.measurement.device and mdm.measurement.device.sensor records. Idempotent.
  2. Readings Import: Health check → Build plan → Call BOMBEOSTATS per endpoint/date-range → Upsert readings per sensor (using _timeStart as measurement_time).

9) Technical Notes

  • Rate limit: 1 request per minute per endpoint. Module enforces waits. If a request is sent within <1 min of the previous one, the API returns false.
  • Fail2ban active on servers: avoid rapid retries with wrong credentials.
  • Response time: first query for a given date range can take >60 seconds (server computes stats on-the-fly). Subsequent calls for cached ranges are faster. Recommended timeout: 180s.
  • _timeStart/_timeEnd are epoch ms (local time, not UTC).
  • Not all variables appear in every row (depends on station sensors).
  • Idempotent readings via upsert(sensor_id, measurement_time).
  • Multiple endpoints supported: one per physical Hermisan server/PLC.
  • Zone names with double brackets ([[EMBALSE B]]) are hidden in Hermisan's main UI. Strip brackets when parsing.
  • BOMBEOCHECK variable names may differ from BOMBEOSTATS (e.g. "Potencia" vs "Potencia Consumida"). Provisioning normalizes these automatically. Sensors store the canonical BOMBEOSTATS name in their variable param.

# ── Hermisan: Get Readings (BOMBEOSTATS) ─────────────────────────────── # GET /API1/BOMBEOSTATS?from=YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS&to=YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS # # Each row is a pumping cycle. Sensors are matched by (pozo_key, variable, # bomba). measurement_time is derived from _timeStart (epoch ms). # # Rate limit: 1 request per minute per endpoint. Chunks by 30-day windows. # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── import time as _time import calendar from datetime import datetime

except Exception as e: items.append({ 'endpoint': ep_key, 'error': str(e), 'chunk': from_str if 'from_str' in dir() else '?', }) ep_errors += 1

items.append({ 'endpoint': ep_key, 'start': earliest, 'end': today_str, 'upserts': ep_upserts, 'errors': ep_errors, 'api_calls': ep_api_calls, }) total_upserts += ep_upserts total_errors += ep_errors total_api_calls += ep_api_calls

b64 = base64.b64encode( json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'hermisan_readings_%s.json' % ( fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_'))
att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
